reason: W naszej grze (dane CulturesNation) część opisu się nie zgadza: mikstury wymagają grzybów, wody, ziół i monet (bez oleju i złota) i warzy je druid w rozbudowanej chatce alchemika; amulety wyrabia mincerz w mennicy; żelazne narzędzia robi cieśla, nie kowal; misę na olej ma dopiero Dom 3 i olej trzeba dopuścić w panelu domu. Zamiast okna z symbolem skrzyni jest okno Asystenta (E), a zamiast żółtych przycisków wolne pola torby w panelu postaci. Nie mamy okna pomocy ani tabeli skuteczności broni, więc dopisek o niej znika; po tym samouczku jest jeszcze samouczek 8 PRO, więc to nie są wszystkie samouczki, tylko wszystkie podstawowe.

lines.from: If you don't find any potions in chests, but you still need them, they can be brewed by a druid in an alchemist's hut. To do this, the druid requires not only mushrooms and oil, but also water and herbs. He also needs gold in order to acquire mysterious and rare ingredients. All Vikings - excepting women and heroes - can be equipped with these special supply, healing and battle potions. Small potions can be used twice, large ones can be used 5 times. Then they are used up.
lines.to: If you don't find any potions in chests, but you still need them, they can be brewed by a druid in an upgraded alchemist's hut. To do this, the druid requires mushrooms, water and herbs. He also needs coins in order to acquire mysterious and rare ingredients. All Vikings - excepting women and heroes - can be equipped with these special supply, healing and battle potions. Small potions can be used twice, large ones can be used 5 times. Then they are used up.

lines.from: Equip your Viking soldiers with the potions by selecting them all - except BJARNI - as a group and pressing the spacebar. Choose the option "CHANGE EQUIPMENT" and give them the potions! You can also tell individual characters how many potions to take of any kind by using the round yellow buttons in the character display. This also opens the equipment register.
lines.to: Equip your Viking soldiers with the potions by selecting them all - except BJARNI - as a group and pressing the spacebar. Choose the option "CHANGE EQUIPMENT" and give them the potions! You can also equip individual characters: click a free bag slot beside the portrait in the character panel and the equipment list opens. Each bag slot holds one potion or amulet.

lines.from: Amulets cannot be manufactured. You either have to find them or purchase them by trading with other tribes. All male Vikings - except your heroes - can be equipped with amulets. They give the bearer certain characteristics and their power is never diminished. There are various kinds of amulets:

lines.from: Have the carpenter make 5 wooden tools and give them to the population by activating the order "Always give wooden tools to civilians" in the extras window (the button with the chest symbol)!
lines.to: Have the carpenter make 5 wooden tools and give them to the population by opening the Assistant window (the Assistant button on the bottom bar or the E key) and switching on "Wooden tools" in the Equipment section!

lines.from: Iron tools increase a worker's productivity even more than wooden tools. In other words, his output becomes even greater. Iron tools are produced by a blacksmith.
lines.to: Iron tools increase a worker's productivity even more than wooden tools. In other words, his output becomes even greater. Iron tools are made by a carpenter from wood and iron in an upgraded carpenter's shop.

lines.from: Have the blacksmith make iron tools and give them to the population using the same procedure as for the wooden tools!
lines.to: Have the carpenter make iron tools and give them to the population using the same procedure as for the wooden tools ("Iron tools" switch)!

lines.from: Outside each dwelling is a metal dish that a woman can fill with oil and use to light the Holy Fire. Once this blue flame begins to flicker, a man can come to this house to pray. This covers his need for religion! Oil is produced by a druid.
lines.to: Outside each dwelling from Dwelling 3 upward is a metal dish that a woman can fill with oil and use to light the Holy Fire, once you allow oil in a dwelling's panel (Household section). Once this blue flame begins to flicker, a man can come to this house to pray. This covers his need for religion! Oil is produced by a druid.
